manifest.title_fil: Mangolekta ng impormasyon sa posibleng pagkalason
objectives_fil: Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
objectives_en: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Maaaring nakalunok ng panlinis ang isang bata
sections.takeaway_en: Case: A child may have swallowed an unknown household cleaner

sections.takeaway_fil: Sanayin ang tawag gamit ang kathang-isip na label habang iniiwasan ang simulated exposure.
sections.takeaway_en: Rehearse the information call from a fictional label while keeping the simulated scene clear of exposure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Lumayo sa amoy at unahing tawagan ang kumpirmadong adviser.
sections.takeaway_en: Move away from the smell and call the verified advice route first.

check.prompt_fil: May matapang na amoy ng kemikal kung nasaan ang lalagyan. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: A sharp chemical smell comes from where the container is. What do you do first?

options.fil: Kunin ang lalagyan para basahin nang malapitan ang label.
options.en: Pick up the container to read the label closely.

options.fil: Painumin ang bata ng maraming tubig para lumabnaw ang panlinis.
options.en: Give the child a large drink of water to dilute the cleaner.

options.fil: Ilayo ang lahat at tawagan ang kumpirmadong adviser.
options.en: Move everyone away and call the verified advice route.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Malalantad ka kung papasok sa amoy. Basahin lamang ang label kung walang exposure. 2: Huwag rutinang painumin nang marami. Sundin ang tagubilin ng poison adviser. 3: Tama. Iwasan ang exposure, ilayo ang iba at unahing tawagan ang kumpirmadong emergency o poison adviser.
check.feedback_en: 1: Reaching into the smell exposes you. Read the label only if you can do so without exposure. 2: Do not give a routine large drink. Follow the instructions of the poison-advice responder. 3: Correct. Avoid exposure, move others away and activate the verified emergency or poison-advice route first.

sections.takeaway_fil: Umiiwas si Lea sa amoy, tumatawag at iniuulat lamang ang ligtas na nalalaman.
sections.takeaway_en: Lea stays clear of the smell, calls and reports only what she can safely know.

sections.takeaway_fil: Walang pagpapasuka, rutinang pagpapainom o inimbentong panlunas.
sections.takeaway_en: No induced vomiting, routine large drink or improvised antidote.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iulat ang label kung ligtas mabasa, oras, paraan, sintomas at edad.
sections.takeaway_en: Report the label if safely read, time, route, symptoms and age.

check.prompt_fil: Sumagot ang adviser sa tawag mo. Ano ang iuulat mo?
check.prompt_en: The adviser answers your call. What do you report?

options.fil: Label kung ligtas mabasa, oras, paraan, sintomas at edad.
options.en: The label if safely read, time, route, symptoms and age.

options.fil: Ang hula mo kung anong lason at ang panlunas na ibibigay mo.
options.en: Your guess of the poison and the antidote you plan to give.

options.fil: Na may nalunok lang ang bata; sila na ang magtatanong.
options.en: Only that a child swallowed something; they will ask the rest.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Ibigay ang label, tinatayang oras, paraan ng exposure, sintomas at edad, saka sundin ang tagubilin. 2: Huwag manghula o mag-imbento ng panlunas. Iulat ang facts at sundin ang responder. 3: Ibigay ang lahat ng ligtas na nakuhang facts: label, oras, paraan, sintomas at edad.
check.feedback_en: 1: Correct. Give the label, estimated time, exposure route, symptoms and age, then follow their instructions. 2: Do not guess or improvise an antidote. Report the facts and follow the responder. 3: Give all the facts you have safely gathered: label, time, route, symptoms and age.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
